authority: AGENT executor interpretation; first two development gaps recorded before execution

findings.finding: No modeled financing/credit-risk or capital-structure response qualifies the supplied real rate or couples it to delivery risk.
findings.disposition: Retain owner-authorized sensitivity-only finance framing; no economic optimum.

findings.finding: No sourced vendor quotation or equipment-quality/performance relationship constrains the correlated HX price multipliers.
findings.disposition: Retain owner-authorized sensitivity-only cost scenario; no physical improvement claim.

findings.finding: Reduced paired exchanger areas remain cheaper than matched baseline under every tested assumption/supply setting.
findings.disposition: Retain bounded purchased-equipment saving; hydraulic/geometry/MHD qualification remains absent.

findings.finding: Near-feed-floor feed-scenario advantage reverses at low neutron multiplication, low availability and low tritium price; high-density feed disadvantage reverses at low availability and low tritium price.
findings.disposition: Report matched rankings and fixed purchase-floor effects, not a robust operating optimum.

findings.finding: High-density demand stays cheaper without credit, and near-feed-floor demand stays more expensive, across the tested matched settings.
findings.disposition: Keep demand responses distinct from hardware savings and unqualified confinement/control.

findings.finding: Availability changes calendar-year gross makeup across fixed breeder feed; tritium price affects initial-stock capital as well as annual purchases.
findings.disposition: Retain both supply scenarios, gross/purchased/curtailed quantities and complete LCOE contributions.

findings.finding: Deposition, U, auxiliary-load, supply and other scientific assumptions remain unqualified even when a constraint is reachable or every evaluated check passes.
findings.disposition: Use conditional sensitivity scope; do not optimize unsupported efficiency or feed assumptions.

findings.finding: All six inherited source controls retain heat-removal failures; literal Raffray also retains balance failure.
findings.disposition: Preserve adverse controls outside accepted-design rankings.
